I’m Dr. Carl Baird — chiropractor and strength coach — and I help adults 40+ overcome joint pain and arthritis so they can stay active and enjoy life. For the past 12 years, I’ve guided adults in building strength and improving movement — the most powerful way to reduce pain and maintain your lifestyle as you age.

On this channel, I show you safe, effective ways to strengthen your body while limiting stress on your joints, so you can stay mobile, active, and confident.

My mission is simple: to help you live stronger, healthier, and happier. I’m excited you’re starting your strength journey with me — let’s get moving!

Stay Strong,
Dr. Carl Baird
